description: BuNo 160724; block-check passes for the A-7E run; displayed on the riverfront plaza beside the destroyer berth. Aerial Visuals fix 30.444117 -91.190311. The ship itself was in drydock at Houma through 2025-26 but the museum and plaza remained open
REPLICA - full-scale reproduction in Flying Tigers markings carrying the number 191; displayed under cover in the museum plaza. Aerial Visuals fix 30.443067 -91.190217
